marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Wind northwest 25 knots diminishing to northwest 15 near noon
and to light early this evening. Wind becoming southeast 15 Thursday
afternoon. Fog patches forming Thursday afternoon. Temperatures minus 8 rising to minus 1 Thursday
evening. Over open water freezing spray ending this
afternoon. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Over open water seas 1 to 2 metres subsiding to 1 or less this
afternoon.<br/>
